text.en: Rounds pierce targets and deal damage over time. Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants.
Rounds pierce targets and deal damage over time. Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants.

Weapon of Sorrow.

Shots fired overpenetrate unlimited targets.
//Unknown value but definitely more than 7...which at that point, might as well be.

Direct hits with this weapon apply poison, dealing <pve 26 /> <pvp [0.4] /> damage every 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds. Multiple instances of poison can be applied to a single target.

Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 10 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.
